title: Random space / one draw per vertex
question: What does a ground feel like when no two neighbours agree?
reference: Every vertex an independent draw under a law (uniform, gaussian, poisson, exponential). Animated when alone; in a slot the ground stays still.
physical_model: Static ground in a slot (animation off, since a floor that moves under the feet is a different artifact). Trimesh collision of the drawn vertices.

slot.note: Fitted by TopologySpace.fit_slot: footprint minus the margin, the lowest point on the pool floor, the highest 0.1 m under the rim, the relief fading to the floor across the edge band. Also stands alone with no slot.

parameters.question: How far can one draw reach?

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.question: Which of the many grounds this law allows?

parameters.label: Relief
